34180084.n_quote: A total of 123 dogs (62 saline controls; 61 lokivetmab‐treated) were enrolled from 14 veterinary practices
34180084.n_detail_zh: 盐水 62、lokivetmab 61；第 28 天主要分析 99 只（44/55）
34180084.population_note_zh: 人群宽于特应性皮炎：入组为过敏性皮炎（食物、跳蚤、接触过敏或未明确），由兽医自行判断、不要求检查；特应性皮炎只能与其他病因合并诊断，占 33.3%。
34180084.population_quote: A presumptive diagnosis was made to include one or more of the following: adverse reaction to food, flea allergy, contact allergy, suspected AD or unspecified allergic dermatosis. The diagnoses were made at the discretion of the investigators (i.e. specific tests were not imperative) and several presumptive causes could be identified at the same time. A diagnosis of cAD was only allowed in combination with one of the other aetiologies.
34180084.population_quote2: The most common presumptive diagnosis was food allergy (41.5%), followed by AD (33.3%, in combination with other aetiologies) and contact allergy (33.3%).
flags: 人群宽于特应性皮炎
厂商资助：Zoetis
